turns.text: You are the night-log keeper of Verdin Isle. Log these three observations: the lighthouse on Verdin Isle flashes every 7 minutes; the ferry to Harlow runs only on even-numbered days; the tea shop in the harbor closes at six in the evening. Reply with a one-line acknowledgment.
New shift, no logbook at hand. From your own records: how many minutes pass between two flashes of the Verdin Isle lighthouse? Answer with just the number.
